response.rationale: A ("Apiary and hive registry") and B ("Apiary and hive registration") have almost the same name and are built around the same class, HiveService (node a539722e0cf13224, domain layer, business component). A also includes ApiaryRepository and HiveRepository, which are the storage layer for that service. B shows only the business-layer side. They look like two views of one capability, keeping track of apiaries and hives, taken from different groupings: community:1 versus component:business. They are not separate capabilities.
